title: Online reseller on marketplaces
tagline: Trading other people’s products on Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho and quick-commerce apps — low capital, fast start.
who: Family businesses adding an online channel

structure.why: Marketplaces accept proprietors with a GSTIN, PAN and bank account. You avoid audit and ROC costs while margins are thin. Convert to an LLP or company when turnover crosses a few crore, when you build a brand, or when liability (returns disputes, counterfeit claims) grows.
structure.alternatives: Private limited if you plan to build private labels or need credit lines from the start.

breakdown: GST and Udyam: free (₹1,000–3,000 if a CA files GST)
Barcodes if you list new ASINs: ₹2,000–5,000
Working capital for stock: the real cost

timeline: GSTIN in 3–7 working days (Rule 14A path), marketplace approval 2–5 days each; selling within two weeks if stock is ready.
taxes: GST registration is mandatory to sell taxable goods through a marketplace regardless of turnover; from 1 Oct 2023 unregistered sellers may sell *intra-state* only, with an enrolment number, and only exempt or small-value cases — most sellers simply register.
Marketplaces collect 0.5% GST TCS and deduct 0.1% income-tax TDS (194-O); both show up as credits to claim.
Composition scheme is incompatible with inter-state marketplace sales — stay regular; QRMP keeps filing quarterly below ₹5 crore.
Income tax on slab rates; presumptive 6% of digital turnover (Section 58) is available up to ₹3 crore for traders.
selling: Amazon (FBA or self-ship), Flipkart (Flipkart Fulfilment), Meesho (no commission, composition sellers allowed), JioMart, Snapdeal, Tata Cliq
Quick commerce via distributors or direct onboarding at scale
ONDC seller apps for zero-commission discovery
sourcing: Wholesale hubs: Sadar Bazar and Gandhi Nagar (Delhi), Crawford Market (Mumbai), Chickpet (Bengaluru), Burrabazar (Kolkata), Surat textile markets
B2B apps: Udaan, IndiaMART, Jumbotail, Amazon Business
Brand distributors — get an authorisation letter to list branded products and avoid IP takedowns
pitfalls: Listing branded goods without brand authorisation — account suspension and IP complaints.
Stocking in a marketplace warehouse in another state without registering there — Rule 14B (from Nov 2026) finally lets you use the warehouse as PPoB; until notified you need an APoB/registration.
Not reconciling returns, RTOs and settlement reports — GST is on the sale, credit notes needed for returns.
Missing MRP/manufacturer/country-of-origin on labels for imported goods — delisting and Legal Metrology penalties.
